truths.truth: Agent-tooling gate red on base, green on last commit, wired
truths.evidence: Ran `.venv/bin/python scripts/gates/check_agent_tooling.py <git archive 215a92b6 export>`: printed pip install, npx prettier and enabledMcpjsonServers fault lines, `3 problem(s)`, rc=1. On HEAD it printed `[ok] the tracked settings allow no package fetch and enable no MCP server`, rc=0. Wired at Makefile:25 inside `lint:` (Makefile:5), which `check:` depends on (Makefile:108). Pre-commit hook id `agent-tooling` is at .pre-commit-config.yaml:333-340, with `files: ^\.claude/settings\.json$`. `check_gates_wired.py` prints `[ok] all 24 gate scripts are wired into the Makefile and pre-commit`. On HEAD, .claude/settings.json allow has no pip/npx rule and there is no enabledMcpjsonServers key. tests/gates/test_agent_tooling.py passed in the named run (35 passed across the four phase test files).

.claude/settings.json on HEAD has no `deny` key. `Bash(git commit *)` (settings.json:24) matches `git commit --no-verify` and `git commit -n`. check_agent_tooling.py has two checks only (FETCHES_CODE, enabledMcpjsonServers) and no deny check. The records attribute the decline to the owner: commit 65274f07 body ('Owner approval (D-13), quoted: "no no verify deny, pip/prettier fine, whatever"'), DISPOSITIONS.md:306 and :336, and the SUMMARY deviation. The AC1 text and UAT item 2 were never changed to match.

truths.truth: eqstage refuses non-loopback url and fails on redirect
truths.evidence: scripts/eqstage/eqstage.js:82-89 `baseOf` throws unless the protocol is `http:` and the hostname is in {127.0.0.1, localhost, [::1]}. It is called first in runJob (:136) and before loggedInFetch in main (:211). main's catch sets process.exitCode=1 (:218-221). Spot-check: `echo '{"url":"http://192.0.2.1:8090",...}' | node scripts/eqstage/eqstage.js` printed `eqstage: url http://192.0.2.1:8090: only http to 127.0.0.1, localhost or [::1] is accepted`, rc=1, with no request made. `redirect: "error"` is set at post.js:41 (stage POST), :61 (pending GET), :114 (login POST) and rows.js:94 (baseline GET). The cookie wrapper at post.js:126 spreads the caller's init. A named run of tests/js/eqstage/eqstage-url.test.js and eqstage-redirect.test.js gave `# tests 10`, `# pass 10`. Both files are in the test-js glob (Makefile:106). Bite: before the fix, baseOf was a bare string transform and no fetch set `redirect`, so the recorder sees requests and the sink is hit, as recorded in DISPOSITIONS.md F-044 Proof.

truths.truth: hqp_section refuses filenames outside the manual
truths.evidence: scripts/hqpdoc_tools.py:264-265 raises SectionFileOutsideManualError when `authority.is_inside(manual, manual / filename)` is false, before is_file/read_text. is_inside (authority.py:178-180) resolves symlinks and `..`, and an absolute filename makes `manual / filename` the absolute path. The MCP server calls `tools.tool_hqp_section(_str_arg(args, "number"))` (hqpdoc_mcp.py:129), so it uses the default root. The same cause is closed in manual_sections (authority.py:211), search_manual (:239), tool_hqp_page (hqpdoc_tools.py:284) and _manual_label_to_file (:118). tests/test_hqpdoc_section.py (parent, absolute and symlink cases) and tests/test_authority_sections.py passed in the named pytest run. Before the fix, `MANUAL / filename` was read with no check.

truths.truth: The three write probes still capture the pristine archive after switching to the shared backup directory
truths.evidence: scripts/probes/absent_plugin/probe_absent_plugin.py:255 `backup = _backup_dir().prepare()` binds a local `backup` in `_run`. This shadows the module-level `async def backup(http)` at :115. `symtable` confirms `backup` is local and assigned in `_run`. As a result, :278 `pristine = await backup(http)` and :294 `await backup(http)` call the BackupDir dataclass instance and raise TypeError (not callable). The crash happens on every run with a safe directory, after the control connect and the state check and before the archive is written. Before 04c0211e, :263 and :279 called the function. mypy did not catch it because `_backup_dir()` returns ModuleType, so `prepare()` is Any. probe_post_reassert.py and probe_profile_post_process.py import the module as `backup_dir` and are not affected. No test exercises the safe path of `_run`; tests/test_probe_backup_dir.py covers only the refusal path.

gaps.name: The three write probes still capture the pristine archive after switching to the shared backup directory
gaps.reason: behavior wrong: 04c0211e shadows the module function `backup` with a local BackupDir in probe_absent_plugin.py `_run`, so the probe raises TypeError on every run with a safe directory and never writes the pristine archive that restore_pristine reads back (D-18).
gaps.evidence: scripts/probes/absent_plugin/probe_absent_plugin.py:255 `backup = _backup_dir().prepare()`. :278 `pristine = await backup(http)` and :294 `await push(http, await backup(http), original, active)` now call the BackupDir instance. :115 `async def backup(http)` is unreachable from `_run`. The failure comes after the control connect and before any write, so the daemon is not touched. tests/test_probe_backup_dir.py exercises only the refusal path.
gaps.missing: Rename the local in `_run` (for example `backup_store`) so `backup(http)` resolves to the module function again. Add an offline test that drives `_run` past the directory check with a stubbed client and asserts the archive is written to `backup_dir.prepare().archive`. The test must be red against 04c0211e.
